newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid market correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid market correction.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended down amid a market correction for a second day as a result of the withdrawl of price fluctuation limit, said brokers.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all- share price index closed 39.27 points or 2.19 percent down at 1,750.99 on a turnover of 94.9 million taka on Sunday. Friday is the weekend in Bangladesh. Of 101 issues traded 28 gained and 72 lost.

Brokers said said prices of most shares dropped after the removal of the 10 percent limit on price fluctuation from Saturday for three days. Monno Jutex shed 900 taka to 4,100, A.M.C.I.Pran lost 106 to 1,149 and Beximco Pharma was down 11 to 188.
